events.subtitle: 30th Anniversary — two-night catalog retrospective

venue.name: Dizzy's Club at Jazz at Lincoln Center

events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents the 30th Anniversary of Steven Bernstein's Sexmob at Dizzy's Club on August 25-26, 2026, with sets at 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM. The quartet is Steven Bernstein on slide trumpet, Briggan Krauss on alto/baritone saxophones, Tony Scherr on bass, and Kenny Wollesen on drums. The band formed in 1996 from a weekly Knitting Factory residency and has remained a working quartet for three decades. The anniversary engagement is programmed as a two-night catalog retrospective: August 25 focuses on recordings from 1996-2011, including Din of Inequity, Solid Sender, Sex Mob Does Bond, Dime Grind Palace, Sexotica and the Medeski collaboration; August 26 covers 2012-2026, including Cinema, Circus & Spaghetti, Cultural Capital, The Hard Way and the 2026 live album Let X=X. Jazz at Lincoln Center's ticketing page shows active inventory for at least the August 26 9:00 PM set at the time of verification.

en.why_it_matters: Sexmob has spent three decades turning slide trumpet, reeds, bass and drums into a language that can move from raw swing to funk, film music and pop deconstruction without losing the band's identity. Dizzy's is not treating the anniversary as a generic greatest-hits booking: the first night traces the 1996-2011 period and the second follows the band from its Fellini project through Cultural Capital, The Hard Way and the new Let X=X era. Hearing the same four musicians look back across that history while they are still an active working group gives the anniversary real editorial weight.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the four sets if New York is already realistically in play, and choose the night by which period of the band you want to hear: August 25 for the early catalog, August 26 for the more recent experimental arc. Two nights and four sets provide enough access that a truly singular one-off elsewhere in the corridor would still take precedence.

es.why_it_matters: Sexmob lleva tres décadas haciendo que trompeta slide, saxos, bajo y batería funcionen como un lenguaje propio capaz de pasar del swing crudo al funk, la música de cine y la deconstrucción de canciones populares sin perder identidad. Dizzy's no está tratando el aniversario como un simple greatest hits: la primera noche recorre 1996-2011 y la segunda sigue a la banda desde su etapa Fellini hasta Cultural Capital, The Hard Way y el presente de Let X=X. Escuchar a los mismos cuatro músicos mirar hacia atrás sobre esa historia mientras siguen funcionando como banda de trabajo le da peso editorial real a la celebración.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los cuatro sets si Nueva York ya está realmente en juego, escogiendo la noche según la etapa que más interese: 25 de agosto para el catálogo temprano y 26 para el arco más reciente y experimental. Dos noches y cuatro sets dan suficiente acceso para que un one-off verdaderamente singular en otro punto del corredor todavía tenga precedencia.
